{{Quote|The Temple's armory stores these artifacts inside its Black Vault. I added the Tzuhakk broadsword after recovering it on Bpfassh.|Mace Windu, ''Book of Sith''|<ref name="BoS" />}}
An '''armory''' existed within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Within the armory was the [[Black Vault]], the Order's storage place for [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith weapons]].<ref name="BoS" /> By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] recorded in a section of [[Sorzus Syn]]'s [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|chronicle]] on [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] weaponry that [[Gender/Legends|he]] placed the [[Tzuhakk broadsword]] in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] armory's Black Vault after retrieving the [[Sith sword|blade]] from<ref name="BoS" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Bpfassh]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi Temple armory was mentioned in ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', a reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] that was published by [[becker&mayer!]] in [[2012]].<ref name="Amazon">{{WebCite|url=http://www.prweb.com/releases/starwars/bookofsith/prweb8875603.htm|text=Just in Time for New York Comic Con, Lucasfilm™ Announces the Discovery of BOOK OF SITH: Secrets from the Dark Side|date=2011-10-13|work=[http://www.prweb.com PRWeb]|archivedate=20111115030034|nolive=1}}</ref>
